a: Validate after blur or submit; avoid yelling on first keystroke.
Every input needs a visible label associated via for/id.
Summarize errors at top and move focus on submit failure.
Allow showing passwords; do not block paste.
If submit is disabled, explain what is missing.
Autosave long forms to reduce data loss.
Confirm irreversible actions with clear consequences.
Use type=email/tel/number for better mobile keyboards.
Show step progress and allow going back.
Confirm successful submits with clear next steps.
